enchantments.tooltip: +15 Enhancement Bonus: +15 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Force Blast 6: This weapon ripples with intense force, dealing 6d6 Force damage on a successful hit, and an additional 6d6 Force damage on a critical hit.
Impact: Passive: The base critical threat range of this weapon is doubled. This does not stack with Improved Critical feat. Vorpal Strikes by this weapon also bypass all Fortification.
Blunt Trauma: This weapon is incredibly dense and delivers especially powerful blows. When rolling a 19 or 20 on a melee attack, your critical multiplier is increased by +1.
Construct Bane 6: This weapon is attuned specifically to disrupt creations, dealing an additional 6d10 bane damage vs. Constructs.

Legendary Remodeling Renegade: 3 Pieces Equipped:+30% Artifact Bonus to Fortification Bypass+15% Artifact Bonus to Doublestrike and Doubleshot+30 Artifact Bonus to Physical Resistance Rating4 Pieces Equipped:+15 Artifact Bonus to Melee and Ranged Power+15% Artifact Bonus to Damage vs. Helpless opponents
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
